title: Mega App Galaxy Upgrade — 100+ Apps Fully Functional
summary: The biggest single-session upgrade ever. All 58+ stub apps rebuilt with real features, the Owner Nexus fixed to work fully offline, Focus Timer got 5 new features, and every app got sort, bulk-delete, search and export.
items: Rebuilt all 58 stub apps from scratch with full localStorage persistence, add/edit/delete, star/favourite, search, category filter, and CSV export.
Added Newest/Oldest/A-Z sort buttons, item count display, and bulk-delete with checkboxes to every app in the ecosystem.
Fixed the Owner Nexus (owner.private.html) to work fully on a static Vercel deployment — all controls now read from localStorage instead of dead API routes.
Upgraded Focus Timer with Pomodoro cycle dots, task label per session, ambient sound picker (Rain/Lofi/Waves/White Noise), productivity score, and 7-day bar chart.
Upgraded Expense Tracker with 7-day income vs expense bar chart, category pill filters, CSV export, and ₹ formatting.
Fixed ecosystem overview in the Owner Nexus to show real data from Notes Vault, Goal Planner, Flashcards, and other apps.
Deployed all changes to production via Vercel — krishiv-new-portfoilo.vercel.app.
